messages:
incidents-bot: Pager: Elevated 502s from inference-gateway -> model-runner service (region: us-west-2). Error spike started ~1794512340. Severity: P1. Oncall: mira (eng-sre). Link: https://incidents/1794512380
mira (oncall): I'm on it. Observed gateway 502s and 5xx coming from model-runner pool ml-runner-*-usw2. Kicking off live debug.
ashok: I'm here, pulling last deploys. Any recent kernel/quant rollout?
joel: Noted higher memory usage on a subset of runners. Could be OOMs. dmesg shows repeated Killed process 1234 (model-runner) out-of-memory.
ops-bot: Auto-mitigation: scaled model-runner pool down to 50% + routed 30% traffic to fallback model variant redwood/llama-clr-1.2-cpu.
mira (oncall): Good. Please also set model-serving.fallback_policy=immediate for affected routes.
ashok: I see a recent canary for quant-attn-kernel at 1794512200. Rolling that back now.
joel: Rolling back kernel canary -> running kube rollout undo for job/quant-kernel-canary.
mira (oncall): For immediate relief: throttling max_concurrency per-runner to 4 and disabling longseq batching.
ashok: Patch applied: set max_concurrency=4 on nodepool ml-runner-usw2-A. Confirmed token throughput back within limits but some 502s persist.
joel: dmesg snippet from runner-12:
```
[ 1234.567890] Out of memory: Kill process 2765 (model-runner) score 134
[ 1234.567891] Killed process 2765 (model-runner) total-vm:8123456kB, anon-rss:5123456kB
[ 1234.567892] segfault at 0 ip 0x7f8abcd123 sp 0x7ffdeadbeef error 4 in libattention_quant.so
```
mira (oncall): Segfault inside quant kernel looks probable. We need to isolate which model variant and input distribution triggers it.
ashok: Pulling stack trace + recent request IDs. Found reproducible failure for seq_len>1024 on quantized llama-variants.
joel: Quick mitigation: enable model variant soft-fallback -> non-quant path for requests with seq_len>1024. Pushing config now.
ops-bot: Config change applied: route longseq -> llama-std (non-quant) with 20% ramp.
taylor-cs: Customer impact: reported latency spikes for customer AcmeCorp (high), others minor. Notifying Acme support channel.
mira (oncall): @taylor-cs ack. Mark incident impact: partial degradation for enterprise customers on long sequences.
ashok: We're also seeing KV-cache growth on some runners—could be a leak when quant-kernel hit segfault path. Creating a hotfix branch to add guard rails and OOM checks.
joel: Temp hotpatch: add process supervisor to restart model-runner on OOM and disable persistent KV-cache retention on failure.
mira (oncall): Handing off live debug to joel for hotfix and ashok for rollback + monitoring. I'll stay until stable then pass to tomorrow's EU oncall.
joel: Hotfix PR opened: github.com/redwood/runner/pull/4312. Applying to canary 2 nodes.
ops-bot: Canary hotfix deployed to 2 nodes. Observability: 502 rate reduced from 12% -> 3% in 15m.
mira (oncall): Excellent. Next steps: follow-up postmortem, revert canary rollback if stable, add regression test for seq_len>1024 on quant kernels, tighten preflight for kernel rollouts.
sre-manager: Add action item: run mem-leak stress test on quant kernels across sample inputs. Owner: ashok. Due: 48h.
taylor-cs: Communicated interim update to AcmeCorp: mitigation applied, engineers investigating root cause, will provide 1hr update.
mira (oncall): Closing pager escalation. Mark incident status: mitigated but under investigation. Handoff: joel (hotfix owner) and ashok (rollback+tests) for follow-up.
incidents-bot: Incident 1794512380 status update: MITIGATED -> monitoring. Postmortem owner requested: ashok.
